note: Recorded from a real omp 19.1.0 rpc-ui child (isolated HOME and agent dir, a fake Anthropic server). static = get_model_picker, set_model with thinkingLevel/role, get_state's configuredThinkingLevel/thinkingLevels, set_thinking_level auto, an invalid level, an unknown model, the subagent-model commands that do not exist. midstream = set_model while a reply is streaming. helper = a root set_model (also with a stray subagentId) while an async helper runs: the helper keeps its model.
views: get_state data is a view: `model` is provider/id, `sessionFile` is a placeholder and `keys` lists every key the real payload had; the other fields are as sent. Event frames are summaries (message text cut to 70 characters); eventsBefore arrived before the command's response, eventsAfter after it.
